name: listening_ports
description: Every TCP port something is listening on right now, with the program that owns it. Good for "what is running" and for a server that won't start.

name: gpu_report
description: The graphics card's own report from nvidia-smi: name, temperature, load, memory, power.

name: startup_apps
description: What starts with Windows for this user: name and command, so "why is it slow at login" has an answer.
